_why: Fixture manifest, keyed by NAME -> S3 key (Zac, 2026-09-20). A clip URL on a command line is a presigned string that expires, is not in the tree, and is unrecoverable the next morning -- which is exactly how a run got blocked asking for a paste. A NAME is durable, reviewable and diffable; the URL is derived at use time and never written down.

_fixture_corpus:
FIVE RIGHTS-CLEAR TALKING HEADS (Zac, 2026-09-20). Every talking-head fixture before these was Zac, one take of one person, so nothing measured on them generalised across people, rooms, lighting or skin tone. These are five different people in five different places: two of the five are English, one Hindi, one Spanish, one unverified; four of the five are darker-skinned subjects. ALL FIVE REQUIRE ATTRIBUTION (four CC BY-SA 4.0, one CC BY 3.0) — the author and the Commons page are recorded on every row and must travel with any published use. LIMITS, stated rather than discovered later: all five are OUTDOOR or entrance-lit, because a second search round for free-licensed INDOOR/studio talking heads of usable length returned ZERO; th_baiga_hi is pillarboxed; th_simurali_in is a three-quarter profile rather than to camera; th_estudiante_es is a wider full-body framing.

GEOMETRY KEY NAMES, CORRECTED 2026-09-20. The five corpus entries were written
with `duration_s` and `resolution: "WxH"` while the eleven before them use
`duration`, `width`, `height`. The manifest reader tests the canonical three, so
it reported all five as MISSING GEOMETRY while the geometry was sitting in the
file under other names -- the same shape as renaming `language` to `typed_in`
under a reader that still read `language`. Re-measured with ffprobe on the exact
local artefacts that were uploaded and written under the canonical keys, with
`fps` and `r_frame_rate` added because a rate is what the canvas has to follow:
  th_lagos_en       1920x1080  23.976  55.943s
  th_kolkata_en     1280x720   28.000  72.571s
  th_baiga_hi       1920x1080  25.000  53.800s
  th_estudiante_es  1080x2400  30.000  39.000s
  th_simurali_in    1920x1080  25.000  41.640s
FIVE SOURCES, FOUR FRAME RATES AND THREE ASPECTS, none of them 1080x1920@30 --
which is the prestage default, and is what all five would have been rendered at.
th_lagos_en's numbers agree with what ChatCut read back independently after
import (1920x1080, 23.976, 55.9s).
